description: This file defines a custom exception class 'EventStreamDataException' within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing errors received via an EventStream.

classes.name: EventStreamDataException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing errors from an AWS EventStream, extending RuntimeException and including methods to get error code and message.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the error code and message, and calls the parent constructor with the message.

methods.name: getAwsErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the AWS error code associated with the exception.

methods.name: getAwsErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the error message associated with the exception.
